1.  Vanta raises $150M Series C led by Sequoia at a $2.45B valuation
Security compliance automation startup Vanta announced a $150 million Series C led by Sequoia Capital, valuing the company at $2.45 billion. The round brings total funding to $353M.
techcrunch.com/2024/07/23/vanta-series-c-funding
 
2.  Vanta - Crunchbase Company Profile & Funding
Vanta is a trust management and security compliance automation platform. Headquarters: San Francisco, California. Founded: 2018. Founder: Christina Cacioppo.
www.crunchbase.com/organization/vanta
 
3.  Vanta | SOC 2, HIPAA, ISO 27001, PCI, and GDPR Compliance
Vanta automates the complex and time-consuming process of SOC 2, HIPAA, ISO 27001, PCI and GDPR compliance certification. Trusted by 16,000+ customers, from startup to enterprise.
www.vanta.com
